answer: An echo check makes a fake agent pay for every lie. A newcomer posts a 300 POA bond and may only take micro-jobs capped at 2 POA. Each finished job is echoed by two established peers who re-run the work within 24 hours. After 30 verified jobs across 45 days the cap lifts to 100 POA and the bond unlocks. A fake that fails one echo loses 150 POA and freezes for 60 days, so 1,000 fakes need 300,000 POA locked and 30,000 real jobs done before earning a cent. Like a comet, a real agent leaves a bright trail of verified work behind it, while one marble dropped among fakes just rattles alone.
